title: Atomically validate and admit Online requests
acceptance: Mode, durable session, gate and lease are rechecked in one serialized admission before next(); concurrent revoke/logout/gate/mode tests deny the stale request.

title: Close independent envelope ownership and recovery boundaries
acceptance: No-envelope requests cannot self-create independent authority; proven managed-to-independent promotion updates envelope and durable session together; stale independent sessions cannot write after managed recovery.

title: Make admin and user handoff session roles mutually exclusive
acceptance: Admin-to-user and user-to-admin reuse of one cookie cannot preserve the opposite role or bypass user fences.

title: Remove synchronous full-state writes from ordinary request accounting
acceptance: Managed admission/finish and heartbeat use serialized runtime mutations without per-event fsync; independent pending-sync evidence persists before next().

title: Bind login OAuth state to the initiating browser
acceptance: A callback without the exact host-only HttpOnly SameSite=Lax provider cookie is rejected before state consumption; binding flow remains session-bound.

title: Make password removal a version-fenced cross-repository command
acceptance: Removal carries an immutable version, stale removal cannot erase rebound material, Online accepts exact fenced remove and clears local password fields, and tests cover retry/rebind.

title: Defer offline nodes without permanently blocking controller rebuild
acceptance: Offline/stale nodes enter a durable deferred state counted ready for global reopening; their old credential can only rejoin through the rebuild reconciliation path later.

title: Keep early third compatibility heartbeat within the database CHECK
acceptance: A third compatible observation before the minimum window remains verifying with observation count 2; resolution writes count 3 only after time criteria pass.

title: Provide durable release for data-fault write gates
acceptance: Recovery creates a durable, retryable, idempotent release command fenced by exact fault/user/handle/epoch facts; Online clears only the matching data-fault gate.

title: Do not block offline-backup scanning on one workflow
acceptance: The scan schedules durable work without executing an up-to-eight-hour snapshot inline; later reconciliation executes it.

title: Reclaim controller backup retries and expired leases
acceptance: Due retry_wait and expired running runs are reclaimable after restart, each attempt uses a fresh command identity, all early errors are observable, and archive hashing is streamed.

title: Revalidate recovery readiness inside repair and backup transactions
acceptance: Scheduling/claiming cannot create new work after an active controller rebuild closes the new-operation gate, even if the process-local check raced.

title: Rate-limit agent registration and authenticated agent traffic
acceptance: Registration is bounded per source IP and signed heartbeat/poll/ack/result traffic is bounded per authenticated node without breaking normal long polling.

title: Load the production browser heartbeat entry
acceptance: The normal browser bundle imports the heartbeat implementation and an admin-only handoff does not generate invalid user telemetry.

title: Directly cover drain wait and timeout release
acceptance: Tests hold an in-flight request through the wait loop, observe write_drain_timeout, and prove the snapshot gate is released.

title: Close implementation-report partial gaps and enforce reproducible acceptance
acceptance: Re-audit every current partial against later Q&A, add missing cross-platform unit/component/contract tests and a reproducible opt-in Linux/PG acceptance entrypoint, remove absolute-path scripts, and record honest coverage/evidence.

title: Regression-only verification of already implemented priority items
acceptance: Restore lease recheck, conflict publish locking, Conflict polling, R22 lockout/audit read side, Round60 baseline and hardcoded-secret removal remain closed; only source defects found during regression become fixes.

title: Regression-only verification of the three pre-landed Online fixes
acceptance: Chat/group render counts, per-model Free Gemini formats and reset-all username validation remain green and are not reimplemented.

title: AI findings await seven explicit requirement confirmations
acceptance: Do not modify before main-flow acceptance; afterwards ask the seven requirement changes one by one, then implement Phase 0 through 6B.
